operations.detail: Queue, same-owner lease, web page and zero runtime outputs were re-read from remote.
ArcGIS item-data error bodies could previously be treated as generic text and reach cache validation.
ONS confirms NSUL and ONSUD are CSV products with field headings and six-week release cadence.
Official Esri documentation confirms the /data endpoint streams the actual item file and derives content type from its MIME type.
Bodies beginning with doctype, HTML or XML markers fail content-shape validation.
Bodies beginning with JSON object or array markers fail content-shape validation.
NSUL and ONSUD require UPRN plus one of PCDS, PCD, PCD2 or POSTCODE before cache promotion.
Open UPRN ZIP members require UPRN, X/Y coordinates, latitude and longitude headers.
The LIDS relation package requires at least one CSV or TXT member containing a UPRN header.
HTML, JSON, missing postcode, valid ONS CSV, OS coordinate and LIDS fixtures passed local preflight.
The same 74-step pipeline now includes 31 hydration tests and 80 official source checks.
Queue is locked to current hydration, test, pipeline, manifest and source-registry blob SHAs.
Two new content-shape artifacts raised the remote-readback matrix to 63 entries.
No content-shape runtime verification, hydrated package, exact join candidate or business row is claimed.
